responsibility: Implements creation, reuse, lifetime management, and auxiliary metadata handling for GIMPLE SSA_NAME nodes. This file owns the per-function SSA name table and freelists, version allocation and compaction, initialization/finalization and statistics, copying/duplicating/releasing SSA names, preservation or reset of attached pointer points-to/alignment info and non-pointer range information, and the pass that compacts released names after optimization, so it is the core storage-management layer for SSA values rather than a transformation pass over GIMPLE statements.
same_name_distinction: This file implements the storage-management layer for SSA_NAME objects: allocation/reuse, freelists, version compaction, metadata copying/reset, and the pass that compacts released names. In contrast, gcc/tree-ssanames.h is the public API and metadata-definition header for using and querying SSA names.
